advanced.submittingSearchSendsGetApiV1CompaniesWi: Submitting Search sends GET /api/v1/companies with a NIT or name, fixed-code filters and bounded pagination. The FastAPI adapter normalizes inputs, escapes controlled Socrata queries and applies filters and ranking before LIMIT/OFFSET. Live name ranking runs across all matching source rows; the API requests one extra row to determine whether another page exists rather than calculating an expensive total.
advanced.eachOfficialRegistrationRowHasItsOwnPers: Each official registration row has its own persisted UUID, keyed by source plus source row identity. NIT is indexed but is not unique. Shared NITs, branches and separate registrations are not merged. Exact NIT/DV evidence, exact names, normalized names and partial matches stay distinguishable; the platform does not invent confidence percentages.
advanced.searchResultsAreUpsertedIntoPostgresUsin: Search results are upserted into Postgres using SQLAlchemy. Companies and aliases support later lookup; private source records preserve payload versions and hashes. Source timestamps, retrieval times and report observation times remain separate. Public APIs return allowlisted evidence, never the complete raw payload or database credentials.
advanced.httpxAppliesBoundedRetriesAndConcurrency: HTTPX applies bounded retries and concurrency. If an official source fails, usable cached evidence can be returned with an explicit stale warning. Without usable evidence, the request fails instead of reporting zero matches. Profile reads use the cached registration; an explicit refresh retrieves only that same RUES source row. Browser search results stay in memory for 30 minutes, and returning from a profile does not automatically repeat the search.
advanced.theImportActionOpensAFreshServerSideBrow: The import action opens a fresh server-side browser, visits the official RNVE directory and selects DESCARGAR EMISORES → REPORTE EXCEL. It does not use a private API or copied browser credentials. If the public controls fail, an operator can upload the same issuer-only XLSX. Only this one dataset requires initial import; there is no mandatory bulk securities or quote seed.
advanced.theExistingParserRejectsOversizedArchive: The existing parser rejects oversized archives, formulas, macros, external workbook links, schema changes, duplicate regulatory keys and future report dates. Issuers are upserted by source and regulatory type/code. Exactly ten-digit corporate identifiers are split into NIT/DV only when the checksum validates; trust, fund and foreign-entity identifiers are not truncated into corporate identities. A transaction records a snapshot and reconciles links. UI imports default to incomplete coverage: absence is not a verified negative. Full-directory completeness requires a separately reviewed count and explicit CLI attestation.
advanced.theBvcCheckboxSearchesTheImportedIssuerD: The BVC checkbox searches the imported issuer directory for candidate identities, retrieves issuer-specific RNVE securities evidence and obtains eligible NITs before asking RUES for the result page. It is not restricted to companies previously opened or to rows visible on the current page. Discovery is bounded to ten matching issuers; broad searches must be narrowed.
advanced.aVerifiedIndicatorRequiresAVerifiedIssue: A verified indicator requires a verified issuer relationship and ordinary-share records whose reported market is BVC. NIT collisions, incompatible verification digits and name-only candidates remain unresolved or potential. RNVE registration, BVC registration events, current listing, trading activity and ownership are separate findings. A blank check is not evidence of no registration.
advanced.5CapitalMarketsRetrievalAndQuoteFallback: 5. Capital Markets retrieval and quote fallback
advanced.openingCapitalMarketsForAVerifiedIssuerR: Opening Capital Markets for a verified issuer retrieves missing or stale RNVE summaries and securities reports. Chromium renders public summary pages; HTTPX retrieves the public issuer-specific report. Successful summary and securities caches last 24 hours independently, and failures have independent 15-minute cooldowns. Opening a page without a verified issuer cannot retrieve issuer-specific evidence.
advanced.quoteResolutionTriesBvcThenLaRepublicaTh: Quote resolution tries BVC, then La República, then official SFC daily-price reports, requiring exact identity evidence at each step. La República discovers links from its public stock directory (24-hour cache, at most 100 links), checks up to three candidate technical sheets, and rejects ambiguous matches. Labels only route requests; NIT, ANN or exact legal name establishes identity. Verified mappings retain URL, discovery time and directory hash. Quotes are cached separately (15 minutes by default). More than one common-equity record blocks quote attribution rather than selecting an arbitrary instrument. SFC daily weighted averages are labeled as such, not presented as a current last trade. Manual source refresh targets only the selected connector; the directory uses its import action.
advanced.theLocalViteServerServesReactAndProxiesR: The local Vite server serves React and proxies relative /api requests to FastAPI. In the production Compose stack, Caddy serves compiled assets and HTTPS, forwarding /api to a single Uvicorn worker. Postgres has no public port. Evidence artifacts and database files use private persistent storage. Migrations run explicitly before startup; an empty database schema contains no invented demo companies.
advanced.importsArePostOperationsWithA10MibStream: Imports are POST operations with a 10 MiB streamed upload cap and serialized execution. Loopback development allows same-origin operators; deployed servers require a server-configured administrator key. Import downloads have a one-minute cooldown. Production request limits and company-wide manual-refresh intervals are memory-bounded and assume one API process. Backups quiesce writers and preserve both database and evidence; restore checks use an isolated disposable database. Deployment configuration being present does not mean the site is hosted or monitored automatically.

secopWorkflow.title: 6. Government Contracts: exact supplier matching
secopWorkflow.body: The company must have a verified nine-digit base NIT. An explicit query or refresh requests SECOP II electronic contracts through server-side Socrata filters on supplier identification, never the government buyer. Nine-digit source identifiers match the base NIT; ten-digit identifiers must also match the confirmed verification digit. Names alone do not establish a match.
secopWorkflow.detail: A bounded, explicitly ordered retrieval validates the schema and exact identifiers, then deduplicates contract versions and stores a screening run with source evidence. The configurable row cap defaults to 5,000; exceeding it fails the check and displays an alert without publishing partial totals. Decimal COP aggregates count only verified, nonduplicated contracts; values are reported contract amounts, not payments or revenue. Successful results use an independent cache (24 hours by default). Concurrent refreshes are blocked; timeouts and failed requests retain prior successful evidence with a stale warning. No matches and inability to check remain distinct.
